rationale: With the Chief in dissent, Justice Thomas assigns and is best positioned to write a stare decisis- and history-forward opinion treating consent-by-registration as a valid waiver under Pennsylvania Fire and Insurance Corp. of Ireland. Multiple concurrences are likely to cabin the holding (e.g., emphasizing notice/clarity or flagging Commerce Clause limits), while the dissent may split between a Roberts institutional/workability opinion and a Jackson voluntariness-focused opinion.
